cfbd.label: CFBD PPA
cfbd.note: Equal-game averages of prior-week CFBD PPA/play; offense higher / defense allowed lower. Independent provider cross-check, correlated with EPA, not an extra probability boost. Missing games remain unknown; season aggregate is not used for historical cutoffs.

used.reason: Virginia Cavaliers offense +0.144 (10 games) vs Virginia Tech Hokies defense allowed +0.128 (10 games); Virginia Tech Hokies offense +0.162 (10 games) vs Virginia Cavaliers defense allowed +0.163 (10 games); CFBD PPA Virginia Cavaliers: offense +0.158 (10 games), defense allowed +0.123 (10 games); CFBD PPA Virginia Tech Hokies: offense +0.128 (10 games), defense allowed +0.154 (10 games). Offensive EPA: higher is better. Defensive EPA allowed: lower is better; negative is favorable. These are equal-game averages of non-garbage-time EPA/play, not opponent-adjusted ratings. The existing CFB spread forecast already uses opponent-adjusted EPA alongside other metrics; do not add these descriptive averages to its probability again. Passing/rushing are context, not a separately validated matchup edge. Missing values mean unknown. Check sample, opponent strength, injuries and pace; EPA alone is not a spread, total, player projection or bet instruction. Source: local ESPN-derived EPA, not CFBD PPA; provider values are not interchangeable.
Insufficient distinct decision dates

ignored: CFBD policy: underdog points require price-aware spread validation; no team-quality veto

cfbd.note: Equal-game averages of prior-week CFBD PPA/play; offense higher / defense allowed lower. Independent provider cross-check, correlated with EPA, not an extra probability boost. Missing games remain unknown; season aggregate is not used for historical cutoffs.

used.reason: Eastern Michigan Eagles offense -0.016 (9 games) vs Western Michigan Broncos defense allowed +0.119 (9 games); Western Michigan Broncos offense +0.168 (9 games) vs Eastern Michigan Eagles defense allowed +0.206 (9 games); CFBD PPA Eastern Michigan Eagles: offense -0.033 (9 games), defense allowed +0.176 (9 games); CFBD PPA Western Michigan Broncos: offense +0.102 (9 games), defense allowed +0.093 (9 games). Offensive EPA: higher is better. Defensive EPA allowed: lower is better; negative is favorable. These are equal-game averages of non-garbage-time EPA/play, not opponent-adjusted ratings. The existing CFB spread forecast already uses opponent-adjusted EPA alongside other metrics; do not add these descriptive averages to its probability again. Passing/rushing are context, not a separately validated matchup edge. Missing values mean unknown. Check sample, opponent strength, injuries and pace; EPA alone is not a spread, total, player projection or bet instruction. Source: local ESPN-derived EPA, not CFBD PPA; provider values are not interchangeable.

CFBD Western Michigan Broncos: offense gap +0.136 PPA/play (higher better), defense-allowed gap -0.082 (lower better). No joint offense/defense disadvantage at the 0.05 thresholds; original edge requirement retained.

Offensive EPA: higher is better. Defensive EPA allowed: lower is better; negative is favorable. These are equal-game averages of non-garbage-time EPA/play, not opponent-adjusted ratings. The existing CFB spread forecast already uses opponent-adjusted EPA alongside other metrics; do not add these descriptive averages to its probability again. Passing/rushing are context, not a separately validated matchup edge. Missing values mean unknown. Check sample, opponent strength, injuries and pace; EPA alone is not a spread, total, player projection or bet instruction. Source: local ESPN-derived EPA, not CFBD PPA; provider values are not interchangeable.

cfbd.note: Equal-game averages of prior-week CFBD PPA/play; offense higher / defense allowed lower. Independent provider cross-check, correlated with EPA, not an extra probability boost. Missing games remain unknown; season aggregate is not used for historical cutoffs.

used.reason: Delaware Blue Hens offense +0.173 (7 games) vs Kennesaw State Owls defense allowed +0.181 (7 games); Kennesaw State Owls offense +0.103 (7 games) vs Delaware Blue Hens defense allowed +0.189 (7 games); CFBD PPA Delaware Blue Hens: offense +0.124 (7 games), defense allowed +0.200 (7 games); CFBD PPA Kennesaw State Owls: offense +0.019 (7 games), defense allowed +0.159 (7 games). Offensive EPA: higher is better. Defensive EPA allowed: lower is better; negative is favorable. These are equal-game averages of non-garbage-time EPA/play, not opponent-adjusted ratings. The existing CFB spread forecast already uses opponent-adjusted EPA alongside other metrics; do not add these descriptive averages to its probability again. Passing/rushing are context, not a separately validated matchup edge. Missing values mean unknown. Check sample, opponent strength, injuries and pace; EPA alone is not a spread, total, player projection or bet instruction. Source: local ESPN-derived EPA, not CFBD PPA; provider values are not interchangeable.

used.reason: UCLA Bruins offense +0.150 (8 games) vs Minnesota Golden Gophers defense allowed +0.061 (7 games); Minnesota Golden Gophers offense -0.024 (7 games) vs UCLA Bruins defense allowed -0.156 (8 games); CFBD PPA UCLA Bruins: offense +0.155 (8 games), defense allowed -0.223 (8 games); CFBD PPA Minnesota Golden Gophers: offense -0.040 (7 games), defense allowed +0.030 (7 games). Offensive EPA: higher is better. Defensive EPA allowed: lower is better; negative is favorable. These are equal-game averages of non-garbage-time EPA/play, not opponent-adjusted ratings. The existing CFB spread forecast already uses opponent-adjusted EPA alongside other metrics; do not add these descriptive averages to its probability again. Passing/rushing are context, not a separately validated matchup edge. Missing values mean unknown. Check sample, opponent strength, injuries and pace; EPA alone is not a spread, total, player projection or bet instruction. Source: local ESPN-derived EPA, not CFBD PPA; provider values are not interchangeable.

used.reason: UCLA Bruins offense +0.150 (8 games) vs Minnesota Golden Gophers defense allowed +0.061 (7 games); Minnesota Golden Gophers offense -0.024 (7 games) vs UCLA Bruins defense allowed -0.156 (8 games); CFBD PPA UCLA Bruins: offense +0.155 (8 games), defense allowed -0.223 (8 games); CFBD PPA Minnesota Golden Gophers: offense -0.040 (7 games), defense allowed +0.030 (7 games). Offensive EPA: higher is better. Defensive EPA allowed: lower is better; negative is favorable. These are equal-game averages of non-garbage-time EPA/play, not opponent-adjusted ratings. The existing CFB spread forecast already uses opponent-adjusted EPA alongside other metrics; do not add these descriptive averages to its probability again. Passing/rushing are context, not a separately validated matchup edge. Missing values mean unknown. Check sample, opponent strength, injuries and pace; EPA alone is not a spread, total, player projection or bet instruction. Source: local ESPN-derived EPA, not CFBD PPA; provider values are not interchangeable.

cfbd.note: Equal-game averages of prior-week CFBD PPA/play; offense higher / defense allowed lower. Independent provider cross-check, correlated with EPA, not an extra probability boost. Missing games remain unknown; season aggregate is not used for historical cutoffs.

used.reason: Virginia Tech Hokies offense +0.200 (7 games) vs SMU Mustangs defense allowed +0.170 (7 games); SMU Mustangs offense +0.215 (7 games) vs Virginia Tech Hokies defense allowed +0.061 (7 games); CFBD PPA Virginia Tech Hokies: offense +0.166 (7 games), defense allowed +0.119 (7 games); CFBD PPA SMU Mustangs: offense +0.214 (7 games), defense allowed +0.133 (7 games). Offensive EPA: higher is better. Defensive EPA allowed: lower is better; negative is favorable. These are equal-game averages of non-garbage-time EPA/play, not opponent-adjusted ratings. The existing CFB spread forecast already uses opponent-adjusted EPA alongside other metrics; do not add these descriptive averages to its probability again. Passing/rushing are context, not a separately validated matchup edge. Missing values mean unknown. Check sample, opponent strength, injuries and pace; EPA alone is not a spread, total, player projection or bet instruction. Source: local ESPN-derived EPA, not CFBD PPA; provider values are not interchangeable.

ignored: CFBD policy: totals/player props need a separate validated projection rule

Offensive EPA: higher is better. Defensive EPA allowed: lower is better; negative is favorable. These are equal-game averages of non-garbage-time EPA/play, not opponent-adjusted ratings. The existing CFB spread forecast already uses opponent-adjusted EPA alongside other metrics; do not add these descriptive averages to its probability again. Passing/rushing are context, not a separately validated matchup edge. Missing values mean unknown. Check sample, opponent strength, injuries and pace; EPA alone is not a spread, total, player projection or bet instruction. Source: local ESPN-derived EPA, not CFBD PPA; provider values are not interchangeable.

used.reason: UTSA Roadrunners offense +0.164 (7 games) vs Florida Atlantic Owls defense allowed +0.368 (7 games); Florida Atlantic Owls offense +0.213 (7 games) vs UTSA Roadrunners defense allowed +0.194 (7 games); CFBD PPA UTSA Roadrunners: offense +0.176 (7 games), defense allowed +0.151 (7 games); CFBD PPA Florida Atlantic Owls: offense +0.191 (7 games), defense allowed +0.299 (7 games). Offensive EPA: higher is better. Defensive EPA allowed: lower is better; negative is favorable. These are equal-game averages of non-garbage-time EPA/play, not opponent-adjusted ratings. The existing CFB spread forecast already uses opponent-adjusted EPA alongside other metrics; do not add these descriptive averages to its probability again. Passing/rushing are context, not a separately validated matchup edge. Missing values mean unknown. Check sample, opponent strength, injuries and pace; EPA alone is not a spread, total, player projection or bet instruction. Source: local ESPN-derived EPA, not CFBD PPA; provider values are not interchangeable.

cfbd.label: CFBD PPA
cfbd.note: Equal-game averages of prior-week CFBD PPA/play; offense higher / defense allowed lower. Independent provider cross-check, correlated with EPA, not an extra probability boost. Missing games remain unknown; season aggregate is not used for historical cutoffs.

used.reason: Central Michigan Chippewas offense +0.063 (7 games) vs Eastern Michigan Eagles defense allowed +0.189 (8 games); Eastern Michigan Eagles offense +0.035 (8 games) vs Central Michigan Chippewas defense allowed +0.190 (7 games); CFBD PPA Central Michigan Chippewas: offense -0.006 (7 games), defense allowed +0.263 (7 games); CFBD PPA Eastern Michigan Eagles: offense -0.004 (8 games), defense allowed +0.158 (8 games). Offensive EPA: higher is better. Defensive EPA allowed: lower is better; negative is favorable. These are equal-game averages of non-garbage-time EPA/play, not opponent-adjusted ratings. The existing CFB spread forecast already uses opponent-adjusted EPA alongside other metrics; do not add these descriptive averages to its probability again. Passing/rushing are context, not a separately validated matchup edge. Missing values mean unknown. Check sample, opponent strength, injuries and pace; EPA alone is not a spread, total, player projection or bet instruction. Source: local ESPN-derived EPA, not CFBD PPA; provider values are not interchangeable.

decision_memory.note: Recorded decisions and descriptive trends. Historical passes before rollout cannot be reconstructed. Reviews do not change strategies, create wagers, or establish skill.

reasons.reason: Fade waits for an actual accepted target bet
No exact eligible contract and probability
No losing target with 30 independent training games
Quote timing is invalid or stale
Version created after observation or event has started; no retrospective entry

research_lab.training: Daily frozen versions use outcomes settled before creation; correlated bets are averaged per game. Later observations alone enter prospective evaluation.
research_lab.note: Shadow selections do not spend bankroll or enter the accepted-ticket tape. Unit returns are hypothetical. Missing final results and identical-contract closing references remain unknown.

agency_progression.policy: Sportsbook evidence determines roles. The bottom quarter of losing members with at least 10 games moves to research; at least four experienced members are needed and held seats count toward the quota. Reassigned researchers pause new bets in both competitions. Three proven founders are required for a new office: each 200 games / 60 dates and positive conservative returns, plus 50 forward original-strategy games / 14 dates after policy activation. Existing offices and all history remain. Return from research requires forward validation and half-unit sportsbook probation. Agency rewards are paper progression credits, not betting cash or real money.

data_access.note: Rule-based agents query shared NBA API/nflverse snapshots. Queries are timestamped and hashed; they do not invoke an LLM or access arbitrary websites.

prop_research.note: One frozen specialist-selected contract per player/stat/game. Owner and leave-one-book-out consensus are paired benchmarks, not separate portfolios. All eligible forecasts and passes are scored; candidate returns are hypothetical units. Usage is a shot/turnover proxy, not official USG%. Conditional on playing; missing results stay unknown. References are not certified CLV.

research_desk.note: Actual recorded history analysis and decision-time reads. Movements visualize records, never create bets. WATCH is information only; a negative segment can cap stakes, never raise them. Reports expire after seven days.

policy: Sportsbook agency concentration: each same-game directional opinion may commit at most 0.25% of the members’ combined conservative bankroll basis, with a floor of one member’s 1% ticket allowance. Same-team spread and moneyline stakes count together across books and line changes. Totals and each player/stat direction have separate buckets; opposing stakes never offset each other. Current open tickets consume room, including retained acceptance-agency exposure after a member moves. Existing tickets keep their terms. This caps copies; it does not force opposite bets or create independent forecasts. New paper stakes: at most 40% committed overall, 10% per sport, 2% per game and 1% per ticket. At most 10% committed beyond 24 hours. Sportsbook NBA/NFL game lines may use 7.5% per sport, leaving 2.5% of bankroll for props within the 10% sport limit. Percentages use the lower of initial bankroll and current cash plus open stakes; profits do not automatically increase limits. Existing locked tickets remain intact, and may exceed new limits until settlement. Model and sportsbook accounts stay separate. Separate $10,000 paper bankrolls. One ticket per agent/game/market (player props: per player and stat, settled only from official box scores; did-not-play props are void and refunded); additional existing unit and prop sub-limits also apply. Quotes must be <=90 minutes old, saved before acceptance and before tip. Soccer three-way winners grade draws as wins only for the draw selection; supported half-line totals and full-game two-way markets retain their contracts. Uncalibrated strategy assumptions; no real wagers.

props.rules: Saved book prices <=90 minutes old before acceptance and tip; saved props-model snapshot before acceptance; one ticket per bettor/game/player/stat; shared Sportsbook Lines bankroll and caps (props at most $500 open per sport and 2.5 units per game); official box-score settlement, explicit zero-minute void; missing or ambiguous results remain open.

nfl.settlement: Exact final stats; positive offensive snaps establish zero-stat participation; posted game data and inactive/reserve roster evidence establish DNP refunds. Unknown participation stays open.
